The consistent 30000ms timeout suggests the pool wait timeout is set to 30s. The circuit breaker opening in inventory-service confirms downstream cascading impact.", "confidence": "high", "confidence_score": 0.88, "suggested_action": "Immediately: check `SHOW PROCESSLIST` in MySQL (or `pg_stat_activity` in Postgres) for long-running queries.
